risk_if_not_implemented: Without Sensitive / Regulated Data Access Mapping, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Uncontrolled Third-Party Security / Privacy Exposure (R-GV-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Encrypting Data In Transit
compensating_control_1.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data in transit.
compensating_control_1.justification: Encrypting Data In Transit (CRY-05) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Data Access Mapping (DCH-09) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Sensitive / Regulated Data Sharing Decisions
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a process to assist users in making information sharing decisions to ensure data is appropriately protected.
compensating_control_2.justification: Sensitive / Regulated Data Sharing Decisions (DCH-08.1) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Data Access Mapping (DCH-09) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Data applicability. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
